mapper.select: /* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSummaryFlight */ SELECT COUNT(*) as FLT_CNT, SUM(RSVT_BDPSG_CNT - RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT) as PSG_CNT FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA WHERE GD_SE_YMD = #{ymd} AND TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D' AND CSHR_STTS_CD != 'SL' AND PSG_CGO_SE_CD = 'Y' AND ARCFT_USE_SE_CD IN ('0', '1') AND GD_FLT_PRPS_CD IN ('00', '05') AND FRY_YN NOT IN ('Y') AND DOM_INTL_SE_CD NOT IN ('D') AND DLY_RSN_CD NOT IN ('2', '3')

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveCastRsltDtl */ SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 12, 5), ':', '') TIME, B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, B.PSG_FCLT_CD, B.PSG_FCLT_NM, A.WTNG_PSG_CNT, A.AVG_PRCS_HR as PRCS_HR, A.AVG_WTNG_HR as WTNG_HR FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 -- LS 랜드사이드 좌석, CC 체크인카운터, CK 셀프체크인, SBD 셀프백드랍, LGT 출국장, LC 출국심사, SC 보안검색대, SR 보안검색대RED AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item})
AND SMLT_ACTL_DT LIKE #{dt} || '%'
AND B.PSG_FCLT_CD LIKE #{psgFcltCdPrefix} || '%'
ORDER BY TIME, B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, B.PSG_FCLT_CD, B.PSG_FCLT_NM

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveXovisRsltDtl */ SELECT CASE WHEN PSG_PRCS_GRD_CD = '01' THEN 'FREE' WHEN PSG_PRCS_GRD_CD = '02' THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN PSG_PRCS_GRD_CD = '03' THEN 'BUSY' WHEN PSG_PRCS_GRD_CD = '04' THEN 'VERY_BUSY' END CGN_STATUS, MIN_VL, MAX_VL FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_PSG_PRCS_GRD WHERE FCLT_GROUP_CD = #{psgPrcsGrdCd} ORDER BY PSG_PRCS_GRD_CD
